description: Use when an agent must decide who an IP belongs to before blocking or trusting it: one IPv4 or IPv6 address against the two authoritative, keyless public sources - RDAP registry data (holder, country, date, abuse contact) via the ARIN-to-RIR chain, and the origin ASN from Team Cymru's DNS service. No city-level geolocation and no VPN/proxy detection: that needs a licensed database this route deliberately does not use. Built for going through a list of IPs one at a time. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.
